backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining the backend for AURAWEAR, including data types (Product, StyleProfile, WardrobeItem, TrendItem, Outfit) and CRUD/query functions for products, style profiles, wardrobes, and trending items.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (homepage, AI Studio, Shop, and other pages) to their source files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of key frontend source files including App.tsx, VirtualTryOnPage, SmartOccasionPage, and CheckoutPage.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point that defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (background, foreground, primary, chart colors, sidebar, etc.).
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the AURAWEAR React app, setting the page title and mounting the app via a root div and the main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (home, shop, studio, wardrobe, try-on, occasion, checkout), wraps everything in CartProvider, and renders a shared Layout with Navigation and a footer.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: Slide-in cart drawer component that displays cart items with images, quantity controls, and a total, and navigates to the checkout page on confirmation.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Fixed top navigation bar with the AURAWEAR logo, desktop and mobile nav links, a cart icon with item count badge, and integration with the CartDrawer component.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Renders a product card with image, category badge, trending indicator, tags, sizes, price, and an add-to-cart button using the CartContext.
frontend/src/contexts/CartContext.tsx: Provides a React context for cart state management, exposing add, remove, update quantity, and clear operations along with derived totals.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication via AuthClient, exposing login/clear functions and identity state through a React context provider and hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes React Query hooks for all backend data operations including products, style profiles, wardrobe items, outfits, and trends.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining Tailwind base/component layers, CSS custom properties for the dark gold-accented theme, and reusable utility classes like glass-card, gold-btn, and tag-chip.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AIStudioPage.tsx: AI Studio page that lets users manage their style profile (body measurements, style preferences) and view personalized trend recommendations and saved outfits, using anonymous principal and React Query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout confirmation page that displays an order summary from the cart context, shows item images by category, and clears the cart on confirmation, redirecting to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page featuring a hero section with an animated AI search demo, feature highlights, testimonials, stats, and a featured products grid; seeds products if none exist.
frontend/src/pages/ShopPage.tsx: Shop page with an AI-powered natural language search bar and category sidebar filters that display products from the backend, showing skeletons while loading.
frontend/src/pages/SmartOccasionPage.tsx: Smart Occasion page where users describe an event and the app generates up to three styled outfit looks by matching products to a detected style keyword, with one-click add-to-cart per look.
frontend/src/pages/VirtualTryOnPage.tsx: Renders a Virtual Try-On page with a 3D avatar built using React Three Fiber that visually reflects selected product colors, alongside size recommendation logic based on user measurements and a product selector UI.
frontend/src/pages/WardrobeOptimizerPage: Provides a Wardrobe Optimizer page where users can add/remove clothing items by category and color, generate outfit combinations from their wardrobe, and fetch AI-powered product suggestions.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom AURAWEAR design tokens (dark backgrounds, gold accents, typography), extended animations, box shadows, and plugin integrations for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Tracks the overall AURAWEAR project state including architecture notes, feature inventory, known issues, image requirements, and versioning metadata for the AI-powered fashion e-commerce platform.
